tool_args.rationale: The three-term subcritical law accounts for the pilot curvature and the gradient contrast in the paid rows. The observations identify its coefficients but do not test the proposed avalanche branch. Submit the identifiable law for fresh confirmation; predictions above the reported onset are extrapolations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All paid observations have s_grad <= 2.35, below the reported onset range. Neither the onset nor the penalty strength can be fitted from these rows.
The Haldane model omits the observed gradient dependence, and Cobb–Douglas lacks the saturation in u_now captured by the three-term model.

considered_alternatives.option: Repeat the open-branch or fine-trajectory probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have already been acquired, and neither reached the reported onset. No listed probe specifically targets the supercritical range.
